# Fonts: the data face of the looks (decisions row 366)

One open face, the data face of the documentation site and of the figures (row 363, point 5). The
site serves it from its own origin, so its policy `default-src 'self'` stands. Prose takes the
system's sans, so no prose face is vendored. Fetched 2026-10-12 on the owner's yes, from jsDelivr's
mirror of the Fontsource npm packages, version 5.2.8, Latin subset.

| File | Face | Axes | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jetbrains-mono/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | weight | 40,404 | `18be452724bfdc236c074ca94a249a7f41a86752c7d04ab258ce9ed5651f6a7e` |

Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono@5.2.8/files/`.

The folder holds the package's `LICENSE`: the SIL Open Font License 1.1, JetBrains Mono by the
JetBrains Mono Project Authors. The site copies the folder whole, licence included.
